# algizian_custom_domain (Resource)

The custom domain of a tenant. Once it is `active` it is the issuer of the tenant (`iss` of every token), so decide it before any client or token depends on the tenant. Create the DNS record from `cname_name` and `cname_target` (for example with the Cloudflare provider) in the same configuration. Custom domains are an add-on of the organization's plan.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "algizian_custom_domain" "myapp" {
  tenant   = algizian_tenant.myapp.slug
  hostname = "login.example.com"
}

# The DNS record comes from the same configuration (Cloudflare shown).
resource "cloudflare_dns_record" "login" {
  zone_id = var.zone_id
  name    = algizian_custom_domain.myapp.cname_name
  type    = "CNAME"
  content = algizian_custom_domain.myapp.cname_target
  ttl     = 1
  proxied = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String) A subdomain you control, for example `login.example.com` (not an apex name).
- `tenant` (String) Slug of the tenant.

### Optional

- `wait_for_active` (Boolean) Wait until the domain is `active` (up to 15 minutes). Leave this off when the DNS record is created in the same run: it can only become active after the record exists, so a wait here would block the record. Run `terraform apply` again, or set this after the record, to wait.

### Read-Only

- `cname_name` (String) Name of the CNAME record to create (the hostname).
- `cname_target` (String) Target of the CNAME record (`cname.algizian.com`).
- `error` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `issuer` (String) `https://<hostname>`, the issuer once the domain is active.
- `ssl_status` (String)
- `status` (String) `pending`, `active` or `error`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# the tenant slug
terraform import algizian_custom_domain.myapp k3x9q2a
```
